# Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron from Türkiye

**Total embedded emissions: 1,850.00 tCO2e**

## Inputs

| Required input | Provided | In table? |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | Yes |
| (b) Country of production | Türkiye | Yes, listed for CN 7201 |
| (c) Quantity | 1,000 tonnes | Yes |

All three inputs are present, so the figure can be computed.

## SEE Selection

The table row for CN 7201 and Türkiye gives a default SEE of **1.85 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 1.85 tCO2e/t × 1,000 t
= **1,850.00 tCO2e**
